text: Artificial intelligence is transforming the modern workplace in significant ways. One of the most visible impacts is automation, where repetitive tasks like data entry, scheduling, and basic customer inquiries are now handled by software. This allows employees to focus on more complex and creative work. Additionally, productivity tools powered by AI—such as smart email filters, document summarizers, and project management assistants—help people complete tasks faster and with fewer errors. However, the rise of AI does not mean humans are replaced. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming the norm: workers guide, review, and improve AI outputs while AI handles routine steps. As a result, many jobs are changing rather than disappearing, requiring new skills like digital literacy and critical thinking. Adapting to this shift is essential for career growth.
